title: Internal Outage Radar: offline scope classification of multi-site service-check snapshots
description:
Internal Outage Radar analyzes a saved JSON snapshot of an organization's own service checks taken from several vantage sites. For each service it reports failed, healthy, unknown and missing checks, whether a site quorum was met, and one deterministic scope class: dependency-wide, likely service-wide, site-local or connectivity-path, no observed failure, or insufficient evidence. Input is strictly validated (schema, duplicate keys, unknown references, quorum and timestamps), and partial coverage is reported explicitly rather than treated as success.

Scope: classifications are scope signals, not root-cause diagnoses; a dependency-wide result means failures overlap, not that the dependency caused them. The tool is not a live monitor, probe runner or network scanner and makes no network requests. The included snapshot is SYNTHETIC.

Usage: Python 3.10 or later, standard library only. Run python3 outage_radar.py --input examples/sample_input.json. Tests: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v (run in CI on Python 3.10 to 3.13).

Citation: cite the concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23057994 for all versions, or the version DOI of the release you used. Source code: github.com/sparkainlp-x/internal-outage-radar. Licence: AGPL-3.0-only; commercial licensing is available (see COMMERCIAL-LICENSE.md).
